description: ViewModel for managing the market state and loading coin data in a cryptocurrency tracking application.

classes.name: MarketsViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel implementation to handle market-related operations and state management for the UI.

classes.name: MarketsUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the different states of the market view, including loading, success with coin data, and error states.

methods.name: loadCoins
methods.description: Launches a coroutine to start price updates from the repository.

methods.name: onCleared
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops price updates when the ViewModel is no longer used.
